description: React component for a dialog that allows users to add, display, and delete category tags.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Updates inputValue state when user types in the text field.

methods.name: handleInputKeyDown
methods.description: Adds a new category tag when Enter is pressed and input is not empty.

methods.name: handleDeleteTag
methods.description: Removes a category tag from the list.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, adds new tag if input is valid, and calls onSubmit callback.
